subject.title: feat(slack): allow configurable App Home views

question: Should OpenClaw support operator-authored inline Slack App Home views as a permanent public configuration contract, including account-level overrides and fallback to the built-in view?
rationale: This is a new user-facing configuration mode, not a repair to established behavior; tests can verify mechanics but cannot choose whether this contract belongs in the supported Slack product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the inline configuration contract
options.body: Accept the extension-owned `appHome.view` and account-override contract after a refreshed branch and redacted live Slack publication/fallback proof.

options.title: Keep the built-in Home view only
options.body: Decline the new public configuration surface and retain the existing fixed OpenClaw Home-tab experience.

options.title: Request a narrower owner proposal
options.body: Pause this PR until Slack-area owners specify a different supported customization boundary or capability model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the inline configuration contract
recommendation.body: Accept the extension-owned `appHome.view` and account-override contract after a refreshed branch and redacted live Slack publication/fallback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main Slack feature ownership could not be established reliably from the supplied review context.
